name: v_cloudflare_requests
comment: Flattened Cloudflare Worker HTTP and non-HTTP invocation metrics
statement:
FROM scopedb.public.cloudflare_worker_events
WHERE event_type = 'worker.invocation'
SELECT
    occurred_at,
    service,
    outcome,
    level,
    method,
    host,
    path,
    status,
    ray_id,
    attributes['invocation_id']::string AS invocation_id,
    attributes['wall_time_ms']::float AS wall_time_ms,
    attributes['cpu_time_ms']::float AS cpu_time_ms,
    attributes['log_count']::int AS log_count,
    attributes['exception_count']::int AS exception_count,
    attributes['colo']::string AS colo,
    attributes['country']::string AS country,
    attributes['asn']::int AS asn,
    attributes['as_organization']::string AS as_organization,
    attributes['user_agent']::string AS user_agent,
    attributes['accept']::string AS accept,
    attributes['referer_host']::string AS referer_host,
    attributes['verified_bot_category']::string AS verified_bot_category
